tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Main Menu page background, and the ground behind the GameScene map. Ground for `ink` (10.2:1) and `ink-muted` (5.3:1).

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: Bottom nav bar. Ground for nav icons: `ink` when selected (13.1:1), `ink-muted` when not (6.8:1).

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: Top-bar stat pills (level, gold, gems, trophies) over `page`: #1f1816 at 79%. Ground for `ink` numbers (14.8:1) and the counters that roll.

tokens.name: hud-pill
tokens.usage: In-match HUD pills (names, base health, wave) over the board: #241c1a at 61%.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Info panel and modal sheets (Image tint over BackgroundInfoPanel.png). Text on it is always outlined: plain `ink` on `panel` is 1.5:1, `outline` around it is 12.8:1.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Card face behind the art (Card_V2 on the deck page and in the collection).

tokens.name: stat
tokens.usage: Stat row pills in the info panel (tab buttons use the near-identical #8e8e8e). Its `gain` text is outlined: 2.7:1 without the outline.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim behind the tutorial and modals: black at 72%.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Dark sheets: the tutorial text box today (#14171f at 95%), and the refusal toast this system adds. `ink` on it is 16.1:1, `deny` 5.2:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Every label, number and icon. Always Fredoka Bold with `outline` around it, which is what keeps it legible on `panel`, `mint`, `cta` and the card tints. On `page` alone: 10.2:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Deselected nav icons and slot tabs (MenuNavButton, DeckSlotBar); resisted damage numbers. 6.8:1 on `nav`, 5.3:1 on `page`.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The black text outline baked into the Fredoka-Bold SDF material (_OutlineWidth 0.463), the troops' silhouette outline and the towers' hard drop shadow.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Face colour baked into Button.png, the sprite under every plain button; an Image tint multiplies it.

tokens.name: button-lip
tokens.usage: Bottom lip baked into Button.png (37px at 1300 pixels per unit). It disappears while the button is held.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Battle button face (Button_Yellow.png). One per screen; it breathes when idle. Its label is `ink` inside `outline` (18.1:1 for the outline).

tokens.name: cta-lip
tokens.usage: Battle button's baked bottom lip. It disappears while the button is held.

tokens.name: upgrade
tokens.usage: Upgrade button as rendered: Image tint #6bff78 multiplied by Button.png's #d5d5d5 face. Glows with `attention` while an upgrade is affordable.

tokens.name: upgrade-lip
tokens.usage: Upgrade button's bottom lip (#6bff78 × the sprite's #a0a0a0 lip).

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Positive deltas: '+4.5' on stat rows, '+N' copies, a level gained. Outlined, like all game text.

tokens.name: tint-orange
tokens.usage: Orange family: Dart, Chain, Mortar towers; Cisma, Swarm troops. A card's feedback (ghost, rings, sparks) wears the card's own tint.

tokens.name: tint-pink
tokens.usage: Pink family: Square, Needle, Beacon towers; Ram, MiniBoss troops.

tokens.name: tint-purple
tokens.usage: Purple family: Slam, Shard towers; Shadow, Miragem troops.

tokens.name: tint-plain
tokens.usage: Colourless cards: Circle, Stinger, the support towers, every spell, SpawnEnemy. Their feedback stays white.

tokens.name: rarity-common
tokens.usage: Common: level text, the level strip on the card, and the reveal burst when a Common is won.

tokens.name: rarity-common-soft
tokens.usage: Common secondary: the inner ring and late sparks of its reveal.

tokens.name: rarity-rare
tokens.usage: Rare: level text, level strip, reveal burst.

tokens.name: rarity-rare-soft
tokens.usage: Rare secondary.

tokens.name: rarity-epic
tokens.usage: Epic: level text, level strip, reveal burst. On `panel` it needs its outline (1.2:1 without).

tokens.name: rarity-epic-soft
tokens.usage: Epic secondary.

tokens.name: rarity-legendary
tokens.usage: Legendary: level text, level strip, reveal burst (7.7:1 on `page`).

tokens.name: rarity-legendary-soft
tokens.usage: Legendary secondary.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Map shapes. Reserved for the board: no feedback is ever mint, so an effect is never mistaken for the map.

tokens.name: mint-shade
tokens.usage: Map shape shadows.

tokens.name: mana
tokens.usage: Mana bar fill and card cost (6.8:1 on `page`). Every mana beat (gain tick, full glow, spend drain) is drawn in it.

tokens.name: mana-track
tokens.usage: Mana bar track, which is the hand frame (a dashed Shapes rounded border). `mana` on it is 4.1:1.

tokens.name: mana-gain
tokens.usage: '+N mana' popups (Fonte grants).

tokens.name: mana-short
tokens.usage: Card cost text while unaffordable; it blends to `mana` as the mana arrives.

tokens.name: short-clock
tokens.usage: The radial 'clock' over an unaffordable card covering the missing fraction: #393939 at 63%.

tokens.name: deny
tokens.usage: Every refusal: mana bar flash, blocked ghost, refused upgrade, the toast's icon. Always with a shake and a word, never colour alone. 3.4:1 against `place-ok`, so the pair differs in lightness.

tokens.name: card-flash
tokens.usage: CardBase refusal overlay (alpha 0 to 0.55 to 0). A second red beside `deny`; fold it into `deny`.

tokens.name: hit-flash
tokens.usage: Enemy hit tint for `dur-flash`. Coloured on purpose: the art is white, so a white flash would not read on unarmoured enemies.

tokens.name: dmg
tokens.usage: Damage numbers.

tokens.name: dmg-heavy
tokens.usage: Heavy-hit numbers (a hit worth 20% of max health or more), drawn at 1.5x.

tokens.name: dmg-resist
tokens.usage: Hits cut by off-colour armour: grey and smaller, so armour is learned by watching it work.

tokens.name: place-ok
tokens.usage: Valid placement: a solid ring and a check. Blocked placement is `deny` with hatching and a cross, so the two never rely on hue.

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: Placement ghost body today: #c0c0c0 at 43%. This system tints it with the card's own colour at the same alpha.

tokens.name: range
tokens.usage: Range ring while placing or after tapping a tower: #dfdfdf at 24%.

tokens.name: range-next
tokens.usage: Next-level range ring in the upgrade preview: #66ff66 at 30%.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: The tutorial highlight ring (at 30% today). The one 'ready' colour: an affordable upgrade, a card that just became playable, a new card in the collection.

tokens.name: sparkle
tokens.usage: End colour of VFX_UpgradeSparkle; the particles of every celebration.

tokens.name: dust
tokens.usage: End colour of VFX_TowerDust: a tower landing.

tokens.name: blast
tokens.usage: Square and Mortar explosion sprite.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Ice spell (its zone at 21%). Proposed frozen-tower tint, replacing today's pure #0000ff.

tokens.name: frozen
tokens.usage: Frozen tower tint today (ClientTowerGFX), swapped instantly. Placeholder: replace with `ice`.

tokens.name: hasted
tokens.usage: Hasted tower tint today, swapped instantly.

tokens.name: zone-haste
tokens.usage: The zone Haste, Rift and Ferrugem share today: #ffd94d at 40%.

tokens.name: zone-rage
tokens.usage: Rage zone: #4cffe1 at 40%.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Coin icon, gold counter, wave label; the coins that fly in a payout (9.0:1 on `page`).

tokens.name: gem
tokens.usage: Gem icon and counter.

tokens.name: trophy
tokens.usage: Trophy icon and counter.

tokens.name: name-you
tokens.usage: Your username in the match HUD and on the VS screen.

tokens.name: name-foe
tokens.usage: The opponent's username in the match HUD and on the VS screen.

tokens.name: hp-you
tokens.usage: Your base health label and heart (8.5:1 on `page`); every 'your base was hit' beat.

tokens.name: hp-foe
tokens.usage: The opponent's base health. 4.2:1 on `page`: large text (50px HUD numbers) only.

groups.name: Game UI
groups.note: Authored TMP sizes in canvas units at the 1080x1920 CanvasScaler reference. Fredoka Bold everywhere, always with the black SDF outline (`outline`).

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: VICTORY!, DEFEAT!, VS, and the wave banner.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: The card's name on the info panel.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: HUD numbers, card cost (44.85 to 50.9), every counter that rolls.

styles.name: level
styles.usage: The level strip on a card.

groups.name: Feedback text
groups.note: Added by this system: text that only exists for a moment.

styles.name: float-number
styles.usage: Damage numbers and '+N mana' popups (in world space: about 0.5 units tall).

styles.name: toast
styles.usage: The refusal toast: `ink` on `sheet`, `deny` icon, replacing ScreenWarning's bare 68.3 white text.

spacing.note: Canvas units. The game has no spacing scale; these are the stat grid's, the one layout tuned by hand.

tokens.name: gap-stat-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal gap between stat rows on the info panel (StatsParent grid, 300x80 cells).

tokens.name: gap-stat-y
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between stat rows; the pitch the stat rows stagger in at.

tokens.name: margin-stat
tokens.usage: Space held back below the stat grid (statsBottomMargin), so a shrunk table never ends flush on the frame.

radius.note: Measured from the UI sprites, in canvas units.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Every button sprite (Button, Button_Blue/Cyan/Yellow): 254px corners at 1300 pixels per unit.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: The hand frame that is also the mana bar (Shapes rounded border, thickness 28, dashed).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Top-bar pills, the mana cost badge, the refusal toast, the level pips.

duration.note: Seconds in Unity, milliseconds here. Existing values are quoted from the code; the rest are new.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: New. Pointer down on any button or card: to `scale-press`. Buttons get Unity's 0.1s colour tint today and no scale.

tokens.name: dur-select
tokens.usage: Card select lift and drag scale-up (CardBase Select/Drag, 0.12s).

tokens.name: dur-release
tokens.usage: Pointer up: back to rest through `ease-pop`'s overshoot (CardBase Release, 0.18s).

tokens.name: dur-flash
tokens.usage: Hit flash (HitFeedbackSettings.FlashDuration 0.09).

tokens.name: dur-hitstop
tokens.usage: Heavy-hit freeze, per enemy (HitStopSeconds 0.06). Never Time.timeScale: on the host that slows the match for both players.

tokens.name: dur-punch
tokens.usage: Commit punch when a card is played: 1.1 to `scale-commit` to 0 (0.22s).

tokens.name: dur-fall
tokens.usage: New. The last stretch of a drop onto the board (a tower landing, a spell striking), on `ease-fall`.

tokens.name: dur-pop
tokens.usage: Something appearing or snapping: nav select, card Enter Pop, page snap, camera snap-back (all 0.3s today).

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: New. A landing's squash (`land-x` by `land-y`) settling back to rest on `ease-settle`.

tokens.name: dur-deny
tokens.usage: Refusal shake: card art ±`shake-card`, mana bar ±`shake-bar` (0.32s).

tokens.name: dur-panel
tokens.usage: Modal open, `scale-panel-from` to 1 (info panel, 0.35s). Closing takes `dur-select` on `ease-in`; it is instant today.

tokens.name: dur-travel
tokens.usage: Card returning home (0.4s OutExpo), camera slide (0.4s), a card flying to a deck slot, coins flying to a counter.

tokens.name: dur-count
tokens.usage: New. A number rolling to its new value: gold, copies, stats, base health.

tokens.name: dur-spawn
tokens.usage: Tower scale-in, 0.01 to 1.06 to 1 (0.7s).

tokens.name: dur-levelup
tokens.usage: A new tower level popping in (0.9s).

tokens.name: dur-celebrate
tokens.usage: New. A card upgrade, end to end: charge, burst, level flip, stat rows ticking.

tokens.name: dur-toast
tokens.usage: New. A refusal toast on screen. ScreenWarning runs about 2.9s today; a reason is read at a glance.

tokens.name: dur-banner
tokens.usage: Wave banner rise (WaveWarningCanvas, 2s).

tokens.name: dur-shake
tokens.usage: Short camera shake (CameraFeedback.Shake on Square/Mortar blasts, 0.12s).

tokens.name: dur-shake-long
tokens.usage: New. Long camera shake: base hit, heavy spell landing.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: New. Between items that move as a list: stat rows, slots compacting, coins leaving.

tokens.name: stagger-reveal
tokens.usage: New. Between reward tiles on the end screen, so each one gets its own beat.

easing.note: Each curve is named for the DOTween Ease it reproduces.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Ease.OutCubic: anything arriving. Page snap, camera slide, the tutorial text box.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Ease.InCubic: anything leaving. Popups closing, a played card being consumed.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Ease.InOutCubic: travel with both ends on screen (card to deck slot, coins to counter).

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Ease.OutBack (1.70158): appear, select, release. Nav select, panel open, sort flip, range ring.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Ease.OutQuad: press down, colour fades (the mana bar's rest colour returning).

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: Ease.OutExpo: a card returning to the hand.

tokens.name: ease-anticipate
tokens.usage: Ease.InBack: the wind-up before a launch (upgrade charge, troops leaving).

tokens.name: ease-fall
tokens.usage: Ease.InQuad: things dropping onto the board (Fireball, a tower landing).

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Ease.OutElastic with amplitude 1, period 0.4: a landing settling. Use it on the size of a squash, not on a whole object.

tokens.name: ease-breathe
tokens.usage: Ease.InOutSine: idle loops (the Battle button breathing, a ready glow) and the intro fade.

scale.note: Multipliers on an object's rest scale.

tokens.name: scale-press
tokens.usage: New. Held down: every button, every card.

tokens.name: scale-select
tokens.usage: Card selected in hand (CardBase Select).

tokens.name: scale-drag
tokens.usage: Card being dragged (CardBase Drag).

tokens.name: scale-nav
tokens.usage: Selected nav and slot tab (MenuNavButton, serialized 1.15).

tokens.name: scale-panel-from
tokens.usage: Where a modal starts when it opens (info panel bump).

tokens.name: scale-pop-peak
tokens.usage: Overshoot of Enter Pop (0.6 to 1.06 to 1) and the tower spawn (0.01 to 1.06 to 1).

tokens.name: scale-commit
tokens.usage: Peak of the commit punch before a played card collapses.

tokens.name: punch-soft
tokens.usage: New. A counter tick, an icon receiving a coin, a stat row landing (DOPunchScale strength).

tokens.name: punch-hard
tokens.usage: The mana counter refusing (1 to 1.35 to 1), a level-up bounce, a reward tile landing.

tokens.name: hit-squash
tokens.usage: Heavy hit, 1 to 1.3 to `hit-rebound` to 1 over 0.18s.

tokens.name: hit-rebound
tokens.usage: The rebound after `hit-squash`.

tokens.name: land-x
tokens.usage: New. Width at the instant a tower or card lands. Pair with `land-y`: width times height stays about 1.

tokens.name: land-y
tokens.usage: New. Height at the instant of landing.

tokens.name: breathe
tokens.usage: New. Peak of an idle breath: the Battle button, an affordable Upgrade button.

tokens.name: lift-card
tokens.usage: How far a selected card rises (CardBase moves its Juice node to y 22).

tokens.name: shake-card
tokens.usage: Card art refusal shake, decaying over `dur-deny`.

tokens.name: shake-bar
tokens.usage: Mana bar refusal shake; every other refused button uses it too.

tokens.name: rise-banner
tokens.usage: How far the wave banner and the old warning text rise (40 to 80).

tokens.name: rise-toast
tokens.usage: New. How far a refusal toast slides in.

tokens.name: tilt-drag
tokens.usage: Maximum lean of a dragged card (spring: lean 7, recovery 60 degrees per second).

tokens.name: tilt-deny
tokens.usage: New. Rotation wobble added to a refused button's shake.

shake.note: Camera shake as a share of screen height. The match camera is orthographic size 6, so 1% is 0.12 units.

tokens.name: shake-micro
tokens.usage: 0.05 units: a Square or Mortar blast on screen (today's only shake, CameraFeedback.Shake(0.12, 0.05, 35)).

tokens.name: shake-small
tokens.usage: New. A spell landing (Fireball, Lance, Ice).

tokens.name: shake-medium
tokens.usage: New. Your base being hit.

tokens.name: shake-large
tokens.usage: New. The final blow on a base.

tokens.name: zoom-kick
tokens.usage: Own tower placed: orthographic size 6 to 5.7 and back over 0.28s.

tokens.name: shake-freq
tokens.usage: Shake frequency, in Hz, for every shake above.

haptic.note: Nice Vibrations presets (HapticPatterns.PresetType), played through MMF_NVPreset and gated by the Vibration setting.

tokens.name: haptic-select
tokens.usage: Card select. New: every button press, a page snapping, the ghost snapping onto a slot.

tokens.name: haptic-light
tokens.usage: A card played.

tokens.name: haptic-medium
tokens.usage: Your tower placed. New: a spell landing.

tokens.name: haptic-heavy
tokens.usage: New. Your base hit, at most once per `budget-haptic`.

tokens.name: haptic-success
tokens.usage: Your tower levelled. New: a card upgraded, a new card revealed, victory.

tokens.name: haptic-warning
tokens.usage: A refused play (invalid, no mana). New: every refusal, menu included.

tokens.name: haptic-failure
tokens.usage: New. Defeat.

audio.note: New: the game has no audio yet. Volumes are linear, per mixer group.

tokens.name: vol-ui
tokens.usage: Menu and HUD buttons, toggles, page snaps.

tokens.name: vol-game
tokens.usage: Gameplay: placing, casting, hits.

tokens.name: vol-impact
tokens.usage: Impacts and celebrations: base hit, upgrade, victory.

tokens.name: vol-music
tokens.usage: Music bed; ducked by `duck-music` under celebrations.

tokens.name: duck-music
tokens.usage: How far music dips under a celebration or a banner.

tokens.name: pitch-jitter
tokens.usage: Random pitch either way on every play, so a repeated sound never sounds identical.

tokens.name: pitch-step
tokens.usage: One semitone. Ladders: each coin, each consecutive hit, each stat row ticking climbs one step.

tokens.name: sfx-cooldown
tokens.usage: The same sound cannot restart sooner than this.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (the Color Tint's disabled alpha).

tokens.name: flash-peak
tokens.usage: Peak alpha of the refusal overlay on a card.

tokens.name: ghost-blocked
tokens.usage: New. A ghost over a spot it cannot be placed on.

budget.note: New. Limits that keep a busy board readable and comfortable.

tokens.name: budget-shake
tokens.usage: Camera shakes per second. A request inside the window merges into the running shake (the larger wins).

tokens.name: budget-flash
tokens.usage: Large flashes per second (photosensitivity guideline). Hit flashes on single enemies do not count.

tokens.name: budget-numbers
tokens.usage: Floating numbers alive at once; the oldest fades early.

tokens.name: budget-voices
tokens.usage: Sounds playing at once; the quietest is stolen.

tokens.name: budget-haptic
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between two haptics, so a burst of hits never buzzes continuously.
